title: Pure Shinobird
summary: Shinobird cards with the 2022-23 Stars Align support and generic Spirits, Rank 4s, Links and staples. Shinobirds are WIND Spirit monsters and Rituals that return to the hand each End Phase, and every return fuels the next play. The 2023 cards lead. Shinobaron Shade Peacock counts as Shinobaron Peacock and tributes itself to search a Spirit and a Ritual Spell. Shinobaroness Shade Peacock searches a Spell/Trap that mentions Spirits. Stars Align Above the Shrine Ritual Summons a WIND Ritual straight from the Deck by tributing Spirits. Whenever a WIND monster returns to the hand, it recovers a Spirit or Sets Stars Align across the Milky Way. Shinobird Power Spot searches each time a WIND monster returns to the hand, and Shinobird Salvation destroys a card on each return. Sakitama Normal Summons another Spirit.
